comment.narrative: 3 Expert Exchanges EE were organized together with international initiatives and more than 80 participants each. Currently proposals for policy recommendations based on the EEs and beyond are being explored and developed.EE Just Energy Transition for All Gendering the debate focusing on genderbased challenges in energy transitions. Discussions emphasized the need for including womens perspectives and engaging men as champions for gender equality efforts.EE Participatory Processes in the Just Energy Transition where experts explored various practices of participation and civil society involvement. Insights from processes in Chile South Africa and Spain were shared covering strategies lessons successes and barriers in implementing participatory processes.The Just Transition Toolbox for coal regions knowledge needs in the SouthEastAsian context needs Wuppertal Institute presented its Just Transition Toolbox and experts from coal regions in Indonesia Thailand and India presented on regional examples and discuss on needs to enable a just energy transition in SouthEastAsia.
